### 1. Regulatory Justification
Explain how this feature supports the **AICTE Approval Process Handbook (APH 2026-27)** or institutional security deposit monitoring.

### 2. Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a specific gap? (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when inspecting ghost encumbrances...")

### 3. Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of the workflow or screen you want added.

### 4. Alternative Approaches Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've evaluated.

### 5. Stakeholders Benefitted
- [ ] Technical Institutions / Colleges
- [ ] Regional Scrutiny Officers (SRO/NRO/WRO/ERO/NWRO/SWRO/CRO/SCRO)
- [ ] AICTE HQ Bureau / Member Secretary
- [ ] Commercial Scheduled Banks (Core Banking Nodes)
